title: Stadsängsgatan 63
description: The Swan-labelled apartments in Eriks gränd are divided into two pleasant blocks, with four houses that each embrace a green courtyard. Here you can choose from one-room apartments with a sleeping area, two-room apartments with space for a double bed, smartly planned three-room apartments and four-room apartments for the larger family. The apartments are 30–87 square meters, most with their own balcony or patio. Regardless of the size, the interior standard is high: Parquet floors throughout in all apartments. The kitchen is equipped with an oven, hob and dishwasher. All bathrooms have tiles on the walls and tiled floor, good lighting, chest of drawers and mirror cabinets. The apartments include a washing machine and dryer as standard. Other apartments are prepared for those who want to connect a washing machine and dryer themselves. Washing is done with advantage in one of the several well-equipped laundry rooms in the properties. All apartments have storage either in the apartment or separately outside, for those who want to stow things away. The two blocks also have their own bicycle storage and waste sorting room. The houses themselves have been inspired by old Sigtuna and given a muted color palette. The facades change in color and give a warm and cozy feeling. To create additional comfort, the houses have different heights and types of roofs.
area_description: The district is pleasant and lively with varied buildings. At Silvertorget is a large Lidl store, Olsson's meat and delicatessen market, the WE training facility with gym and yoga, hairdresser, pharmacy, restaurants, health center and dentist. And there will be more service as time goes by. It is also easy to get out in the area. There are ski and running tracks right around the knot and several golf courses in the area, as well as Lake Mälaren, which invites you to activities all year round. And there are schools. In the district there is, among other things, the International English School with classes from six years of operation up to the ninth, and the Raul Wallenberg School exists as a preschool in the area. Communications When you need to get out into the world, it's easy. It is one kilometer to Stora gatan and the center of Sigtuna. You can get to Märsta and Arlanda by car in 10 minutes, to Stockholm in about 40 minutes. If you choose the bus, it is in the center of Sigtuna in about 8 minutes. It takes about 25 minutes from Sigtuna stadsängar to Märsta station, where shuttles and trains run. For those with a car, there are 38 parking spaces on the other side of the street in parking garages, 11 of which have charging spaces for electric cars. There are another 79 parking spaces outside.

area_description: The neighborhood that is emerging in Lillsidan will blend nicely into the cityscape, and you who move in will have a well-planned home with a nice view of the city. area_description: Lindallén is a neighborhood that has been developed with consideration for both people and the environment. The project is Nordic Ecolabelled, which means that it has been reviewed from a life cycle perspective with a focus on the environment throughout the entire process from raw material to finished building. The Swan is the Nordic region's official environmental label and a receipt that the buildings have a healthy indoor environment with as little impact on the environment as possible. Materials used are free from substances harmful to health and the buildings meet tough requirements for low energy use. Bäcklösa is a growing district that connects the central parts of Uppsala with the southern parts. In the attractive area along Dag Hammarskjölds väg, well-planned rental housing is now being added. Lindallén consists of three residential buildings on five floors around a green yard that invites you to play and socialize. It will be a cozy and family-friendly neighborhood where children can run safely between neighboring houses and where it is easy for generations to meet.

title: Svinnegarnsvägen 2A
description: Flexible move-in - Choose a date between the day of contract writing and 3 calendar months ahead. Book a viewing of the home by contacting EHB on phone number 0171-62 58 20 EHB's sheltered housing in Hummelsta gives you who are 65+ the opportunity for a comfortable everyday life with community and activities! In addition to your home, you also get access to several common areas, a gym and a lovely courtyard with a barbecue. Your landlord is also on site at certain times during the weeks. Together with you and your neighbors, we organize meetings and activities based on your interests and wishes! The home is newly created through remodeling and has a new kitchen, bathroom and new surface layers in the living areas. The home has great opportunities to furnish to your liking and needs. Kitchen with beige painted kitchen doors, black handles and laminate worktop with a light slate texture. The kitchen is prepared for the installation of its own dishwasher. Exit to balcony. The bathroom is fully tiled with white tiles on the walls and light gray tiles on the floor. Shower with support handle mounted on wall and rod for shower curtain. Towel dryer. Hall equipped with hat rack and wardrobe. All walls in the home are painted white. All floors in living areas have a single-strip parquet design carpet that mimics rustic, light brown cedar wood. The carpet is easy to care for, wear-resistant and has sound-absorbing properties. The residence is located in house A. Between house A and house C there is an internal passage. Doors in public areas open electronically and there is a lift to all floors. The common laundry room, the room, the social room and the gym are in building A. A common storage room for parking and charging permobiles is in building A, depending on space. Apartment storage for storage is available in building A or B. TV, internet and telephony via fibre. The rent currently includes approximately 15 TV channels and internet with 0.5 Mbit/s. Telephony is not included in the rent. TV, internet and telephone are connected to the broadband socket, there is no antenna socket or telephone jack in the home. You have the opportunity to order your own services for television, internet and telephony from a number of suppliers via Global Connect. You pay for what you order yourself and are not included in the rent. Heating of the home is included in the rent. Your consumption of hot water is not included in the rent. Your consumption of household electricity is not included in the rent. You sign your own electricity contract and can freely choose between companies and energy sources. The accommodation does not offer its own nursing services, but this does not exclude the possibility that you have such services through other companies. The property and all sheltered housing must be smoke-free both inside and outside.
area_description: Hummelsta is a quiet, pleasant place about 8 km west of Enköping and about 25 kilometers east of Västerås. EHB's sheltered housing is centrally located in the community at Svinnegarnsvägen 2. Nearby there are, among other things, a preschool, school, sports hall, bus stop, church center, pizzeria, parcel boxes and the Borgvallen sports ground. There is good public transport to and from Hummelsta and the bus stops are close to the sheltered housing. It takes about 10 minutes by bus to the center of Enköping and 17 minutes to the station and about 30 minutes by bus to Västerås station. There is also a cycle path all the way to Enköping along the old E18. The cycle path is separated from the carriageway by a balustrade. Car spaces are provided via EHB's separate queue for car spaces. There are 22 parking spaces, of which 3 are disabled parking spaces. There are also two visitor parking spaces that are combined with charging points for electric cars. Parking in visitor parking and any electric car charging is paid via an app.

Smoking is prohibited in the entire property, which means that smoking may not take place in the apartment, in the property's public areas or on balconies/patios/attic passages. The smoking ban extends 25 meters from the body of the house.

title: Tegelmästargatan 18
description: Welcome to a bright two-room apartment in tasteful Tegelbruket in the middle of central Knivsta. Here you live in a well-planned home with white-painted walls and large, stylish black windows that let in a lot of daylight. The kitchen is equipped with white kitchen doors, dishwasher and combined fridge and freezer. The fully tiled bathroom has retro glass shower walls and a practical combi washing machine. In the hall there is an easy-to-maintain tiled floor, while in the other rooms you walk on a hard-wearing oak parquet floor. The home also has a well-sized wardrobe. If you want to relax or spend time with loved ones, there is a cozy communal courtyard easily accessible. For the next 10 years, the rent will only increase by 2% per year. Perfect for those who want to keep track of their future expenses.
area_description: The brickyard was built in 2020 and has an excellent location between two large grocery stores. The train station is only 300 m from the residence and from there you can get to Stockholm in about 30 minutes and Uppsala in about 10 minutes. The majority of large grocery stores, preschools, schools, hairdressers and restaurants are nearby. In Knivsta, you are never far from nature. Beautiful nature reserves, mushroom-rich forests and cooling bathing spots are close by, even if you live in the middle of the city centre.

area_description: Together with Valsätra, Gottsunda forms the heart of southern Uppsala. Gottsunda is a place where the needs of both the younger and older generations are met. In the area you will find the center of Gottsunda with its cultural mall (https://www.gottsundacentrum.se/) but also a wide cultural life and forest environment with lovely walking paths. Here there are parks with activities for children and young people, cultural centers and shopping opportunities. In Gottsunda Center you will also find the popular Gottsundabadet (https://gottsundabadet.se/). By bus you get quickly and smoothly into Uppsala's city center and by bicycle as a means of transport you reach the water and the beautiful Vårdsätraviken in just 10 minutes.

title: Hagmarksvägen 19 A
description: Here you have the opportunity to live in a newly built ground floor apartment in family-friendly Gånsta with 3 bedrooms. The home includes a patio and parking is included in the rent. Possibility to move in quickly! Bathroom with tiles and tiles, in other parts of the house there is parquet. Kitchen with dishwasher, oven and hob. The home has its own exhaust air heat pump that supplies the home with heat and hot water. The cost of this is added in addition to the stated rent on the electricity bill. Separate storage is in the adjacent building. The semi-detached house stands on a property with another building (attefall house). The property has an electricity subscription, we provisionally charge SEK 1,000 for household electricity, heating the home and hot water. After 3 months, this is reconciled against actual consumption. The cost of the garbage is also added. We would like to see that you who apply have a fixed income and no payment complaints. Welcome with your application.
area_description: In the immediate area there is the grocery store Ica Nära, newly built playgrounds, preschools and schools. The Bergvreten school (F1-9) and a private school (F1-5) are both about 1 km away and the high school is about 2 km away. Also nice nature in the surroundings.

title: Gredelbyvägen 1C
description: Nordic Ecolabelled rental properties in varying sizes from 1 to 5 rooms and kitchen. Regardless of whether you want to live alone, are cohabiting or about to start a family, here you will find accommodation that suits you. Well-planned and open floor plans with plenty of light. We have selected colors, materials and details that make it easy to create your own and personal feeling. The kitchens, which come in a green or beige color, come from Vedum and are equipped with a dishwasher, oven and induction hob. All white goods come in stainless steel. The larger bathrooms are equipped with a separate washing machine and dryer, and the smaller apartments with a combined washing machine. White chest of drawers with a round LED mirror above. The single-sided apartments facing the yard have a French balcony, apartments from ground floor to floor 4 have a balcony or patio. Located in stairwell 5, there is a shared roof terrace available to all residents
area_description: As a resident of Knivsta, you not only have the lovely nature as a neighbor, but also a very good starting point for commuting to work. The train between Stockholm and Uppsala stops in the middle of central Knivsta, and it takes 29 minutes to reach Stockholm Central and 9 minutes to the station in Uppsala. The Segerdal neighborhood will become Knivsta's new heart in the city center and form the puzzle piece that links the new sawmill square with Knivsta's older, smaller-scale center. From having been a small station community, which then became an industrial community and then a commuter community, Knivsta will now develop into a small town with its own attractiveness. Until 2025, the municipality's vision is for the population to increase from today's roughly 18,000 to 25,000 inhabitants.

area_description: In Eriksberg, you live close to great recreation in the Stadsskogen, Hågadalen and Nåsten. At Västertorg there are, among other things, grocery stores, a health center and a pharmacy. All shops and restaurants in the city are 3 km away and you can get there by city bus or along nice cycle paths.

title: Torpängsgatan 17
description: In the center of Knivsta, 24 minutes to Stockholm, you will find this well-planned 1 bedroom apartment. Modernly designed with an open plan between kitchen and living room. White-pigmented oak parquet throughout, light walls. Light gray kitchen from Vedum equipped with dishwasher, fridge, freezer, oven and induction hob. The bathroom has a shower and a combined washing machine/dryer. The property also has access to a shared laundry room. The property is equipped with solar cells and geothermal heating. Included in the rent: Heating and cold water, Telia TV package base and digital TV box. Not included in the rent: Housekeeping (the tenant signs their own subscription). Hot water (actual cost of consumption is charged in arrears). Broadband and telephony. The property includes a two-level garage with 144 parking spaces.
area_description: In the Ångloket neighborhood, you have walking distance to the center of Knivsta with shops, cafes, restaurants, culture, shopping, services, schools and care. At the same time, you live close to beautiful nature with mushroom forests and ski trails. The Upplandsleden also winds through the municipality, which offers varied hiking through forest and open fields. Knivsta also has a brilliant commuter location. Just a few minutes from your gate is Knivsta station and from here it only takes 8 minutes to Arlanda, 10 minutes to Uppsala and approx. 30 minutes to Stockholm.

area_description: Lindallén is a neighborhood that has been developed with consideration for both people and the environment. The project is Nordic Ecolabelled, which means that it has been reviewed from a life cycle perspective with a focus on the environment throughout the entire process from raw material to finished building. The Swan is the Nordic region's official environmental label and a receipt that the buildings have a healthy indoor environment with as little impact on the environment as possible. Materials used are free from substances harmful to health and the buildings meet tough requirements for low energy use. Bäcklösa is a growing district that connects the central parts of Uppsala with the southern parts. In the attractive area along Dag Hammarskjölds väg, well-planned rental housing is now being added. Lindallén consists of three residential buildings on five floors around a green yard that invites you to play and socialize. It will be a cozy and family-friendly neighborhood where children can run safely between neighboring houses and where it is easy for generations to meet.

title: Svinnegarnsvägen 2A
description: Flexible move-in - Choose a date between the day of contract writing and 3 calendar months ahead. Book a viewing of the home by contacting EHB on phone number 0171-62 58 20 EHB's sheltered housing in Hummelsta gives you who are 65+ the opportunity for a comfortable everyday life with community and activities! In addition to your home, you also get access to several common areas, a gym and a lovely courtyard with a barbecue. Your landlord is also on site at certain times during the weeks. Together with you and your neighbors, we organize meetings and activities based on your interests and wishes! The home is newly created through remodeling and has a new kitchen, bathroom and new surface layers in the living areas. The home has an open floor plan and great opportunities to furnish to your liking and needs. Kitchen with beige painted kitchen doors, black handles and laminate worktop with a light slate texture. The kitchen is prepared for the installation of its own dishwasher. The bathroom is fully tiled with white tiles on the walls and light gray tiles on the floor. Shower with support handle mounted on wall and rod for shower curtain. Towel dryer. Hall equipped with hat rack and wardrobe with space-saving sliding doors. All walls in the home are painted white. All floors in living areas have a single-strip parquet design carpet that mimics rustic, light brown cedar wood. The carpet is easy to care for, wear-resistant and has sound-absorbing properties. The residence is located in house A. Between house A and house C there is an internal passage. Doors in public areas open electronically and there is a lift to all floors. The common laundry room, the room, the social room and the gym are in building A. A common storage room for parking and charging permobiles is in building A, depending on space. Apartment storage for storage is available in building A or B. TV, internet and telephony via fibre. The rent currently includes approximately 15 TV channels and internet with 0.5 Mbit/s. Telephony is not included in the rent. TV, internet and telephone are connected to the broadband socket, there is no antenna socket or telephone jack in the home. You have the opportunity to order your own services for television, internet and telephony from a number of suppliers via Global Connect. You pay for what you order yourself and are not included in the rent. Heating of the home is included in the rent. Your consumption of hot water is not included in the rent. Your consumption of household electricity is not included in the rent. You sign your own electricity contract and can freely choose between companies and energy sources. The accommodation does not offer its own nursing services, but this does not exclude the possibility that you have such services through other companies. The property and all sheltered housing must be smoke-free both inside and outside.
area_description: Hummelsta is a quiet, pleasant place about 8 km west of Enköping and about 25 kilometers east of Västerås. EHB's sheltered housing is centrally located in the community at Svinnegarnsvägen 2. Nearby there are, among other things, a preschool, school, sports hall, bus stop, church center, pizzeria, parcel boxes and the Borgvallen sports ground. There is good public transport to and from Hummelsta and the bus stops are close to the sheltered housing. It takes about 10 minutes by bus to the center of Enköping and 17 minutes to the station and about 30 minutes by bus to Västerås station. There is also a cycle path all the way to Enköping along the old E18. The cycle path is separated from the carriageway by a balustrade. Car spaces are provided via EHB's separate queue for car spaces. There are 22 parking spaces, of which 3 are disabled parking spaces. There are also two visitor parking spaces that are combined with charging points for electric cars. Parking in visitor parking and any electric car charging is paid via an app.

title: Västgötaresan 56 B
description: In the heart of Sävja, Trähuset is emerging - a climate-smart residence built entirely in wood, next door to the Lunsen nature reserve and with services such as a grocery store, pharmacy and schools within easy reach. The property is certified according to Miljöbyggnad Silver and NollCO2, has solar cells for its own electricity and recycled windows. Here you live in a bright and well-planned apartment with parquet floors, white-painted walls and a stylish kitchen from Noblessa equipped with a dishwasher. The bathroom is fully tiled and prepared for a washing machine. Courtyard, bicycle room and modern laundry room make everyday life comfortable. Sustainable housing - for you and the future. Parking spaces on ground level. A parking space can be searched after signing a rental agreement. Charging points will be available.
area_description: The district of Sävja is an established district in the southern parts of Uppsala. The wooden house is a welcome addition to new rental housing in the grown-up environment. Most of the services you need in everyday life can be found in the immediate area. You will find a larger selection with, among other things, a large grocery store, interior design stores, system companies and Ikea in the nearby district of Boländerna. Lockar city has wide and lighted footpaths and cycle paths for those who like to get there on foot or by bicycle. If you want to go by public transport, there is a bus stop right outside the door with frequent bus trips to the city and the travel centre. In addition, there are plans for a future tramway through the area. With the car, you can quickly get out on the E4 for travel in different directions. If you like being out in nature, take your dog, a family member or a group of friends with you and recharge your energy in the forest right next door. For those who like to work up a sweat, there is an easily accessible outdoor gym at Sävja Idrottsplats. The nearby and popular Sunnerstabacken is an obvious place to hang out if you like mountain biking, skiing, snowboarding or sledding. It is also not far to Lake Ekoln for those who like swimming, sailing, fishing and, in the winter when the ice melts, ice skating.

area_description: Kvarngärdet is a popular and close to the city residential area with proximity to everything. Here you will find grocery stores, gyms, parking garages and schools to name a few. With good public transport connections, you can get to Uppsala University in just a couple of minutes, and the same of course also applies to the popular student nations. If you need to travel further, you can walk to the Uppsala Travel Center in just under 10 minutes and then it's off, with whatever method of travel and direction you choose. To the south, Arlanda and Stockholm are easily accessible by train, bus and car. West of Uppsala, you can easily reach Enköping and Västerås with direct buses. With Upptåget you get quickly to Gävle and its intermediate stations. If you want to feel the pulse of the city, it is just as close to Uppsala's city centre. Here you can experience everything from shopping, restaurants, entertainment and various cultural events. Perhaps you prefer a more leisurely pace and would rather enjoy a walk or a moment's rest on a park bench. Lush green areas and parks are literally just around the corner. Not least Kapellgärdsparken, which really has something for everyone. Toboggan run, large open grass areas for picnics, park benches, a skateboard park and skate boule, playground and an outdoor gym. A very popular excursion destination for both adults and children, all year round. Everyone can find their favorite place here.

description: 50% discount on your first three months' rent. The offer only applies to the basic rent. Hot water is billed separately according to own consumption. In Fruängen 2 there are 103 surface-efficient rental apartments with a high standard. Green yard with space for personal meetings and socializing. In the family-friendly surroundings, Fruängen's homes blend in nicely. The houses frame the neighborhood and give a cozy feeling at home. Good walking and cycling paths mean that children can safely walk or cycle to their friends in the area. There is also a preschool in the neighborhood and several preschools and schools are in the immediate area. Nature is knocking on the doorstep with excellent playgrounds to explore for the smaller and lovely trails to discover for both young and old. The facades are plastered and the roofs equipped with energy-giving solar cells. There are excellent apartments here, both for you who live alone, and for those of you who are two or more. The apartments have a fine standard with a well-thought-out floor plan where the white walls and the durable oak parquet are the consistent theme. In the kitchen there is a combined fridge/freezer, stove with hob and dishwasher. The fully tiled bathroom in white is furnished with a shower, washing machine and dryer or combi machine. The common courtyard creates great conditions for socializing. The adjacent playground with swings, playhouse, slide and climbing frame can also become a favorite place for many. For a green oasis, visit Gränbyparken, where you will find playgrounds with a cable car, climbing frames, swings and sandboxes for the little ones. For the active, there is a beach volleyball court, barbecue areas and picnic tables, as well as large green spaces for walking and running. At Gränby sports field there is a colony area, tennis and padel hall, ice rink, athletics arena and soccer fields. Nearby is also a 4H farm with animals and activities for children. The area has several preschools and schools, including Liljeforsskolan and Gränbyskolan. For those who cycle, there are nice footpaths and cycle paths. If you prefer public transport, the bus runs conveniently right outside the door. By car you can quickly reach the E4 for journeys in different directions. Future plans for Gränby include a new swimming pool, a high school with a sports profile and a fast cycle track that will connect the Gränby sports field with the center of Uppsala. The Segerdal neighborhood will become Knivsta's new heart in the city center and form the puzzle piece that links the new sawmill square with Knivsta's older, smaller-scale center. From having been a small station community, which then became an industrial community and then a commuter community, Knivsta will now develop into a small town with its own attractiveness. Until 2025, the municipality's vision is for the population to increase from today's roughly 18,000 to 25,000 inhabitants.

Lockar city has wide and lighted footpaths and cycle paths for those who like to get there on foot or by bicycle. For those who like to work up a sweat, there is an easily accessible outdoor gym at Sävja Idrottsplats. area_description: Welcome to Gränby, a charming district in northern Uppsala! Here you can find everything you need for a comfortable and active lifestyle. Gränbystaden is the heart of the area with over 140 shops, restaurants and service units. For a green oasis, visit Gränbyparken with playgrounds, a beach volleyball court, barbecue areas and large green spaces for walking and running. Gränby sports field offers tennis and padel hall, ice rink, athletics arena and soccer fields. Nearby there is also a 4H farm with animals and activities for children. The area has several preschools and schools, including Liljeforsskolan and Gränbyskolan. For those who cycle, there are nice walking and cycling paths, and the bus runs easily right outside the door. By car you can quickly reach the E4. Future plans for Gränby include a new swimming pool, a high school with a sports profile and a fast cycle track to downtown Uppsala. Gränby has something for everyone. Welcome to discover everything the district has to offer!

Here there are parks with activities for children and young people, cultural centers and shopping opportunities. In Gottsunda Center you will also find the popular Gottsundabadet (https://gottsundabadet.se/). By bus you get quickly and smoothly into Uppsala's city center and by bicycle as a means of transport you reach the water and the beautiful Vårdsätraviken in just 10 minutes.

Bålsta station is also within walking distance, where it only takes 40 minutes to Stockholm Central.

We have selected colors, materials and details that make it easy to create your own and personal feeling. The kitchens, which come in a green or beige color, come from Vedum and are equipped with a dishwasher, oven and induction hob. All white goods come in stainless steel. area_description: As a resident of Knivsta, you not only have the lovely nature as a neighbor, but also a very good starting point for commuting to work. The train between Stockholm and Uppsala stops in the middle of central Knivsta, and it takes 29 minutes to reach Stockholm Central and 9 minutes to the station in Uppsala. The Segerdal neighborhood will become Knivsta's new heart in the city center and form the puzzle piece that links the new sawmill square with Knivsta's older, smaller-scale center. From having been a small station community, which then became an industrial community and then a commuter community, Knivsta will now develop into a small town with its own attractiveness. Until 2025, the municipality's vision is for the population to increase from today's roughly 18,000 to 25,000 inhabitants.

In addition to your home, you also get access to several common areas, a gym and a lovely courtyard with a barbecue. Your landlord is also on site at certain times during the weeks. Together with you and your neighbors, we organize meetings and activities based on your interests and wishes! The home is newly created through remodeling and has a new kitchen, bathroom and new surface layers in the living areas. The home has great opportunities to furnish to your liking and needs. Bedroom with wardrobes. Kitchen with dining area. Beige painted kitchen doors, black handles and laminate worktop with a light slate texture. The kitchen is prepared for the installation of its own dishwasher. The bathroom is fully tiled with white tiles on the walls and light gray tiles on the floor. Shower with support handle mounted on wall and rod for shower curtain. Towel dryer. Hall equipped with hat shelf, wardrobes and storage with space-saving sliding doors. All walls in the home are painted white. All floors in living areas have a single-strip parquet design carpet that mimics rustic, light brown cedar wood. The carpet is easy to care for, wear-resistant and has sound-absorbing properties. The residence is located in house A. Between house A and house C there is an internal passage. Doors in public areas open electronically and there is a lift to all floors. The common laundry room, the room, the social room and the gym are in building A. area_description: Hummelsta is a quiet, pleasant place about 8 km west of Enköping and about 25 kilometers east of Västerås. EHB's sheltered housing is centrally located in the community at Svinnegarnsvägen 2. Nearby there are, among other things, a preschool, school, sports hall, bus stop, church center, pizzeria, parcel boxes and the Borgvallen sports ground. There is good public transport to and from Hummelsta and the bus stops are close to the sheltered housing. It takes about 10 minutes by bus to the center of Enköping and 17 minutes to the station and about 30 minutes by bus to Västerås station. There is also a cycle path all the way to Enköping along the old E18. The cycle path is separated from the carriageway by a balustrade. Car spaces are provided via EHB's separate queue for car spaces. There are 22 parking spaces, of which 3 are disabled parking spaces. There are also two visitor parking spaces that are combined with charging points for electric cars. Parking in visitor parking and any electric car charging is paid via an app.

The property is certified according to Miljöbyggnad Silver and NollCO2, has solar cells for its own electricity and recycled windows. Here you live in a bright and well-planned apartment with parquet floors, white-painted walls and a stylish kitchen from Noblessa equipped with a dishwasher. The bathroom is fully tiled and prepared for a washing machine. Courtyard, bicycle room and modern laundry room make everyday life comfortable. Sustainable housing - for you and the future. area_description: The district of Sävja is an established district in the southern parts of Uppsala. The wooden house is a welcome addition to new rental housing in the grown-up environment. Most of the services you need in everyday life can be found in the immediate area. You will find a larger selection with, among other things, a large grocery store, interior design stores, system companies and Ikea in the nearby district of Boländerna. Lockar city has wide and lighted footpaths and cycle paths for those who like to get there on foot or by bicycle. If you want to go by public transport, there is a bus stop right outside the door with frequent bus trips to the city and the travel centre. In addition, there are plans for a future tramway through the area. With the car, you can quickly get out on the E4 for travel in different directions. If you like being out in nature, take your dog, a family member or a group of friends with you and recharge your energy in the forest right next door. For those who like to work up a sweat, there is an easily accessible outdoor gym at Sävja Idrottsplats. The nearby and popular Sunnerstabacken is an obvious place to hang out if you like mountain biking, skiing, snowboarding or sledding. It is also not far to Lake Ekoln for those who like swimming, sailing, fishing and, in the winter when the ice melts, ice skating.

With SJ you get to Stockholm's central station in about 40 minutes, or why not go about 12 minutes to connect to SL's pink line in Bålsta and travel further on their network? Travel in the other direction with SJ and reach Västerås in about 15 minutes!

area_description: Lindallén is a neighborhood that has been developed with consideration for both people and the environment. The project is Nordic Ecolabelled, which means that it has been reviewed from a life cycle perspective with a focus on the environment throughout the entire process from raw material to finished building. The Swan is the Nordic region's official environmental label and a receipt that the buildings have a healthy indoor environment with as little impact on the environment as possible. Materials used are free from substances harmful to health and the buildings meet tough requirements for low energy use. Bäcklösa is a growing district that connects the central parts of Uppsala with the southern parts. In the attractive area along Dag Hammarskjölds väg, well-planned rental housing is now being added. Lindallén consists of three residential buildings on five floors around a green yard that invites you to play and socialize. It will be a cozy and family-friendly neighborhood where children can run safely between neighboring houses and where it is easy for generations to meet.

area_description: Åkersberg is a neighborhood close to nature just east of the center of Enköping. Here you live both close and secluded at the same time - with a pleasant and familiar feeling. description: In central Knivsta, 24 minutes to Stockholm, you will find this well-planned apartment with 1 room and kitchen. Modernly designed with an open plan between kitchen and living room. White-pigmented oak parquet throughout, light walls. Light gray kitchen from Vedum equipped with dishwasher, fridge, freezer, oven and induction hob. The bathroom has a shower and a combined washing machine/dryer. The property also has access to a shared laundry room. The property is equipped with solar cells and geothermal heating. Included in the rent: Heating and cold water, Telia TV package base and digital TV box. Not included in the rent: Housekeeping (the tenant signs their own subscription). Hot water (actual cost of consumption is charged in arrears). Broadband and telephony. The property includes a two-level garage with 144 parking spaces.
area_description: In the Ångloket neighborhood, you have walking distance to the center of Knivsta with shops, cafes, restaurants, culture, shopping, services, schools and care. At the same time, you live close to beautiful nature with mushroom forests and ski trails. The Upplandsleden also winds through the municipality, which offers varied hiking through forest and open fields. Knivsta also has a brilliant commuter location. Just a few minutes from your gate is Knivsta station and from here it only takes 8 minutes to Arlanda, 10 minutes to Uppsala and approx. 30 minutes to Stockholm.

title: Gamla Uppsalagatan 118
description: In Fortis Nyby you can choose between well-planned 1s, pleasant 2s and 2.5s with high standards and smart floor plans. Each apartment is equipped with a stylish, architect-designed kitchen in tasteful earth colors and lacquered kitchen doors. Feel free to look into our 3D scanning at www.fortisnyby.se where we have furnished a first and a second. Smart energy solutions On the roofs of the houses in the neighborhood are solar cells that create sustainable energy. Together with district heating and energy recovery, it helps heat your home. Our car and bicycle pools also make it easier to live sustainably. Heating, cold water and internet as well as a basic package of TV channels are included in the rent. For more information: fortisnyby.se
area_description: During 2023, Fortis Fastigheter AB has completed 264 modern rental properties with high standards and space-efficient floor plans. The block with all eight houses is in place and right now the green yards of the houses are being planted with attractive areas for community and relaxed socializing with neighbors and friends. For increased safety and accessibility, the houses are without basements. The code-locked apartment storage rooms and other common areas are located at street level where they are easy for you to reach. At street level, there are also several apartments designed as so-called bokals with an entrance directly from the street. Gamla Uppsalagatan is transformed into a city street with inviting facades with lots of glass. Outdoor gym You can work out to your heart's content in the neighborhood's own outdoor gym. Here you can find durable machines for varied and flexible training. Bicycle storage and workshop In Uppsala, the bicycle is the best way to get around. In the shared bicycle workshop, you can service and repair your two-wheeler so you can enjoy it for a long time. Electric bicycle pool On an electric bicycle, it takes no more than 10 minutes to reach central Uppsala. With the shared electric bike pool, the trip becomes easier and you don't have to invest in expensive equipment. The bicycle pool is open to all residents in the block. Car pool For those who do not want to own a car but need easy access, we have created a car pool. Open to all renters with a driver's license to rent electric cars for various needs from our car pool partner. Car parking The car pool's vehicles can be found in the block's parking lot, where you who have a car can rent a space. For you with an electric car, there are charging stations ready for use. Environmental room Here you can leave glass, plastic, newspapers, metal, cardboard and other things for return. We also have an area for recycling where you can leave items

title: Forsbyvägen 3
description: 2.5 rooms and kitchen in popular Knivsta! Now you can move into this apartment, which has undergone an extensive renovation in 2025. The floor plan of the home is well thought out and the apartment has a nice amount of light. The renovation includes a new kitchen, new bathroom, new floors and freshly painted walls. The apartment has white-painted walls and parquet floors throughout. The kitchen interior is white and has a quartz composite top above the sink. The kitchen is also equipped with a stove with ceramic hob, fridge/freezer and dishwasher. The bathroom has fully tiled walls in white and gray tiles on the floor. The bathroom has a shower with a shower wall, underfloor heating and a heated towel rail. The apartment is also prepared for a washing machine and dryer. - This is the first apartment to be rented out after the renovation, so minor deviations from the description may occur. - Security door - Mailboxes in entrance level - Floor plan: Some deviation may occur, and the floor plan may be mirrored. - The apartment includes a storage room. The storage room is located in the attic. - Laundry is in the building, and has a digital booking system. The tenant can pick up his keys to the apartment and the property from 14.00 on the day the apartment is to be occupied. When the day of access falls on a holiday, the following weekday applies according to the Tenancy Act. At the conclusion of the agreement, cold and hot water is included in the rent. However, this apartment is prepared for individual water metering and billing (IMD) of hot water. In the event that the Landlord should decide to introduce individual billing for hot water, part of the rent level will be waived. The rent is based on the 2025 level and can be adjusted after future rent negotiations. Options can be ordered once the contract has entered into force.
area_description: In Knivsta you can enjoy the advantages of the urban area with good service. Here you live within walking distance to the center of Knivsta with its range of shops and restaurants. Here you also have all the general services you need in everyday life, such as a health centre. For families with children, there is a range of preschools and primary schools. At the same time, you are close to the tranquility and seclusion of the countryside. Nearby you have many nice walking areas and excursion destinations nearby. Public transport to and from Knivsta is well developed and both train and bus connections to the city are fast. It doesn't take long to commute to either Stockholm or Uppsala. The train to Stockholm takes 30 minutes, to Uppsala 10 minutes and the train to Arlanda takes 8 minutes.

title: Herrgårdsgatan 35
description: The apartments have modern kitchens from Marbodal with white kitchen doors. The kitchens are equipped with fridge/freezer from Electrolux and stove with oven. Splash guard and countertop in laminate with the appearance of gray concrete. White-pigmented and matte-lacquered 3-strip ash parquet floor throughout living room, bedroom, kitchen and hallway. All rooms have white painted walls and white interior doors. The living room and bedroom have windowsills in gray natural stone. The bathroom is fully tiled in matt white tiles 20x40 mm and gray tiled floor 20x20. Shower area and combined washing machine and dryer. title: Genetikvägen 56
description: The kitchen has white cabinetry from Vedum and a laminate worktop. In addition, the kitchen is equipped with stove, oven, fridge, freezer and prepared with electricity and drainage for a dishwasher. The bathroom has white walls and gray tiles on the floor and is prepared for a washing machine. The apartment also has a lovely spacious balcony. Two common laundry rooms are available for use with fine washing and drying facilities. Between the houses there is a common yard with areas for play and recreation.
area_description: Outside the door, the rural feel is reminded in every breath, even though it is only a few kilometers to the center of Uppsala with all the services you need. The agricultural land with pastures, fields and experimental farms lies side by side with the green areas that are frequently used by schools and preschools. Both Fyrisån and Uppsalaåsen stretch from north to south. Along nice walking and running tracks that start right next door, you can breathe out from the stress of everyday life. Here you will also find the Yellow Path hiking trail that takes you to Studenternas drottsplats in the north and to Skarholmen in the south.

title: Norrbackavägen 1 C
description: The home is newly renovated and has our plus standard, which means you get a modern home with carefully selected materials and high-quality products. It is a brand new kitchen, new floors and freshly painted walls and ceiling. The apartment is equipped with stainless steel appliances, built-in oven, induction hob, built-in microwave, dishwasher, washer/dryer, as well as a security door and glazed balcony. The apartment is only shown in this way. Deviations in floor plan may occur, we reserve the right for possible printing errors. Future rent increases are fixed, 2% every turn of the year from 2026-01-01. At the time of moving in, water is included in the rental cost, but the property owner plans to switch to separate measurement and billing of water shortly.
area_description: The Norrbacka area is within walking distance of Märsta station (approx. 10 minutes' walk), which makes it a perfect commuting distance to both Stockholm, Uppsala and Arlanda airport. The area is child-friendly and has many large green areas. The buildings are low and the houses are two-storey loft corridor houses. In Norrbacka, we offer apartments on Norrbackavägen and Odenselavägen. Right next door there are preschools and also primary and secondary schools.

title: Kastanjegatan 2

The home also includes basement storage and access to the area's laundry room. There is an elevator in the stairwell. Kastanjen is a non-smoking area, which means that smoking is not permitted in either the residence, patio, stairwell or yard. Hall: Gray tiled floor inside front door, parquet floor and white painted walls. There is also a wardrobe in the hall. Kitchen: Kitchen with white doors, white tiles and dark laminate worktops. Equipped with induction hob/oven and fridge/freezer and cleaning cabinet. Prepared for installation of your own dishwasher (not included but can be ordered for a fee). Living room: White painted walls and parquet floor. Bedroom: Bedroom adjacent to the living area with wardrobes and a linen cupboard. Bathroom/Shower room: Fully fitted bathroom with shower, prepared for own washing machine. Balcony or patio: There is also a larger balcony facing the yard with a southwest location. Condition: Overall, the apartment is in good condition. The walls were repainted in 2025 and the floors have some wear but nothing unreasonable. Other spaces Storage: located in the basement. Environmental cottage: is directly adjacent to the farm. Stroller and bicycle storage: available in the basement near the elevator. Other information Internet, television and telephony: Fiber. The actual consumption is then charged. The rent presented at Bostadsförmedlingen includes the standard cost. Housekeeping is not included, the tenant signs their own electricity contract. Parking: Parking is not included in the apartment but is rented out separately. Vacant parking spaces are continuously posted on Uppsalahem's website.

In the courtyard there is a large playground where the children can play, which is sometimes perceived as disturbing.

description: In the heart of Sävja, Trähuset is emerging - a climate-smart residence built entirely in wood, next door to the Lunsen nature reserve and with services such as a grocery store, pharmacy and schools within easy reach. The property is certified according to Miljöbyggnad Silver and NollCO2, has solar cells for its own electricity and recycled windows. Here you live in a bright and well-planned apartment with parquet floors, white-painted walls and a stylish kitchen from Noblessa equipped with a dishwasher. The bathroom is fully tiled and prepared for a washing machine. Courtyard, bicycle room and modern laundry room make everyday life comfortable. Sustainable housing - for you and the future. Parking spaces on ground level. A parking space can be searched after signing a rental agreement. Charging points will be available.
area_description: The district of Sävja is an established district in the southern parts of Uppsala. The wooden house is a welcome addition to new rental housing in the grown-up environment. Most of the services you need in everyday life can be found in the immediate area. You will find a larger selection with, among other things, a large grocery store, interior design stores, system companies and Ikea in the nearby district of Boländerna. Lockar city has wide and lighted footpaths and cycle paths for those who like to get there on foot or by bicycle. If you want to go by public transport, there is a bus stop right outside the door with frequent bus trips to the city and the travel centre. In addition, there are plans for a future tramway through the area. With the car, you can quickly get out on the E4 for travel in different directions. If you like being out in nature, take your dog, a family member or a group of friends with you and recharge your energy in the forest right next door. For those who like to work up a sweat, there is an easily accessible outdoor gym at Sävja Idrottsplats. The nearby and popular Sunnerstabacken is an obvious place to hang out if you like mountain biking, skiing, snowboarding or sledding. It is also not far to Lake Ekoln for those who like swimming, sailing, fishing and, in the winter when the ice melts, ice skating.

description: Nordic Ecolabelled rental housing in varying sizes from 1 to 4 rooms and kitchen. Regardless of whether you want to live alone, are cohabiting or about to start a family, here you will find accommodation that suits you. Well-planned and open floor plans with plenty of light. We have selected colors, materials and details that make it easy to create your own and personal feeling. The kitchens, which come in a green or beige color, come from Vedum and are equipped with a dishwasher, oven and induction hob. All white goods come in stainless steel. The larger bathrooms are equipped with a separate washing machine and dryer, and the smaller apartments with a combined washing machine. White chest of drawers with a round LED mirror above. The single-sided apartments facing the yard have a French balcony, apartments from the ground floor to floor 4 have a balcony or patio. In the Segerdal quarter, we have developed two different interior design concepts – one darker and one lighter – two styles, two kinds of homes. In both design concepts, the basic materials are the same, but the color of the kitchen joinery and the tiles in the bathrooms differ. Concept 1: In the dark interior design concept, the kitchens are in a beautiful fog green tone with smooth doors and knobs in brushed chrome. Worktop and splash guard in durable laminate in a dark grey/black colour, which harmonizes with the gray shade of the kitchen. The bathrooms are fully tiled. Concept 1 – dark Trp 1, 3, 5 and 6 Concept 2 – light Trp 2, 4, and 7
area_description: As a resident of Knivsta, you not only have the lovely nature as a neighbor, but also a very good starting point for commuting to work. The train between Stockholm and Uppsala stops in the middle of central Knivsta, and it takes 29 minutes to reach Stockholm Central and 9 minutes to the station in Uppsala. The Segerdal neighborhood will become Knivsta's new heart in the city center and form the puzzle piece that links the new sawmill square with Knivsta's older, smaller-scale center. From having been a small station community, which then became an industrial community and then a commuter community, Knivsta will now develop into a small town with its own attractiveness. Until 2025, the municipality's vision is for the population to increase from today's roughly 18,000 to 25,000 inhabitants.

title: Brunnbyvägen 104B
description: Pingla housing is located along Brunnbyvägen in the northern parts of popular Alsike. Here you live in a pleasant environment with safe surroundings and an excellent geographical location. Preschool and school are right outside the door, the grocery store a short walk away, as well as the bus that easily takes you to Knivsta or Uppsala. If you want both rural tranquility and proximity to larger cities, Pingla housing is for you. Here you get both. The 46 apartments are housed in a long narrow residential building built on different levels. The house has gray walls with red window frames, the balconies are covered with perforated metal and the roofs in the south are equipped with solar cells. The apartments have parquet floors throughout and brightly painted walls and ceilings. The bathroom has a shower and washbasin commode, the walls are covered with tiles and there is a plastic carpet on the floor. In the kitchen, the smooth doors and drawers are painted in a white color and the worktops are made of laminate. The kitchen is equipped with a fridge and freezer or a combined fridge/freezer, as well as a stove with hob. The apartments are available in many different sizes with varying floor plans. Some of the apartments on the top floor also have sloping ceilings that give the rooms extra character. All one-bedroom apartments have an area of ​​approximately 34 m, two-bedroom apartments 53-68 m and three-bedroom apartments are available in sizes from 70 m all the way up to 93 m. If you are looking for a four-room apartment, there are several square-smart options of 74-83 m, but also an apartment of a whopping 108.6 m. Many exciting variants to suit different family compositions. Shared laundry is centrally located in the building. On the farm there are parking lots and a separate environmental building, but also space for pleasant outdoor activities.
area_description: Alsike is directly adjacent to Knivsta. To Uppsala and Arlanda it is 2 miles and to Stockholm approximately 5.5 miles. In other words, an excellent commuting location. Just under 20,000 people live in the entire municipality of Knivsta, and of those around 5,000 live and enjoy themselves in Alsike. In Alsike there is a grocery store, pizzeria, gym, exercise track, mountain bike course, playgrounds and padel courts. In addition, there are fine forest areas excellent for berry and mushroom picking or walking. Knivsta has a large selection for those who like outdoor life, sports and exercise. To name a few gems, both Lake Mälaren and Lake Valloxen offer nice swimming spots, and Morga Hage and Gredelby Hage are two nature reserves excellent for excursions, picnics or adventures. In addition, Knivsta has a rich and active association life for both young and old. As a resident of Alsike, you can advantageously enjoy living and let your family grow up in a quiet and peaceful area with many options around the corner. Welcome to Pingla housing.

description: If you are interested in looking for the home, you can book a viewing by contacting EHB on telephone number 0171-625820 From March 1, 2024 until February 28, 2026, we will introduce a discount for those who live on Sadelmakargatan. The level of the discount is based on the number of rooms 1 room and kitchen get a SEK 100 per month discount, 2 rooms and kitchen get a SEK 200 per month discount, 3 rooms and kitchen get a SEK 300 per month discount, 4 rooms and kitchen get a SEK 400 per month discount and 5 rooms and kitchen get a SEK 500 per month discount. The discount is automatically deducted from the rental fee and reported separately on the invoice. Open floor plan, balcony, fully tiled bathroom with washing machine and dryer as well as storage that is accessible from inside the home are just some of the features that place these apartments among the most comfortable in Enköping. Fiber is included and you choose for yourself whether you want to add services offered by several providers via GlobalConnect. The rent includes 0.5 Mbit/s data and currently around 15 TV channels in the analogue network. Housekeeping and actual own hot water consumption are added to the rent. Cold water and heating of the home via district heating are included in the rent. For those with a car, there is the option to supplement with your own parking space via EHB's separate queue for car spaces. All images are sample images from the residential area.
area_description: In Sadelmakaren you will probably find the most comfortable and unique rental accommodation that Enköping has to offer! Our newly built residential area was completed in 2015 and has a large courtyard. Fantastic location close to everything! Grocers, restaurants, shops, library, cinema, leisure marina, preschool, school, gymnasium, sports, swimming and ice rink, green areas and several of Enköping's beautiful parks are within approx. 1 km, so you get the best conditions for a practical as well as social and active life! In addition, it is only about 1.5 km to the travel center, which is Enköping's hub for public travel. With SJ you get to Stockholm's central station in about 40 minutes, or why not go about 12 minutes to connect to SL's pink line in Bålsta and travel further on their network? If you travel in the other direction with SJ, you reach Västerås in about 15 minutes!

title: Kantorsgatan 52
description: Student apartment on Kantorsgatan 52 Nice student apartment on Kantorsgatan in the building that Rikshem has chosen to call Gasquen.  The residence was renovated and rebuilt in 2023 and is located in Kvarngärdet near the city, one of Rikshem's most popular residential areas for students. This is a real opportunity for those of you who want a modern and square-smart home during your studies. This apartment has an open floor plan between the kitchen and the room. The room has oak parquet and white painted walls. The kitchen is equipped with smooth white cabinet doors and splash guards in white tiles. There is a fridge/freezer, stove with oven and hood. It is prepared for dishwasher and microwave. The spacious bathroom has fully tiled walls and tiles, shower WC, sink and bathroom cabinet with electrical outlet. Entrance with stylish and practical tiled floor. There is space for outerwear as well as storage in the wardrobe, cleaning cupboard and linen cupboard. There are three shared laundry rooms in the basement. The lift is at Kantorsgatan 54. The apartment has a storage room in the basement. This property offers a TV package from Telia and a broadband connection of 1 Mbit/s. This is included in the rent for you as a tenant when you connect to the open network via fibre. You sign up for broadband subscriptions with higher speeds yourself via Z-market. Heating is included in the fee. Cold and hot water is not included in the fee, the tenant is billed for actual consumption. Parking is applied for separately via Rikshem's website and Aimo-Park. (The rent is stated at the 2025 level and will be adjusted when the 2026 rent negotiations are completed) New tenant may pick up their keys to the apartment and the property no earlier than January 1 from 2:00 p.m. As the 1st falls on a holiday, the following weekday applies according to the Rent Act. The possibility of earlier occupancy is available. Please note that we will not be able to hold any viewings for this property. You as an applicant therefore need to be prepared to make a decision based on the floor plan, which may be mirrored, the pictures and the description.
area_description: Kvarngärdet is a popular and close to the city residential area with proximity to everything. Here you will find grocery stores, gyms, parking garages and schools to name a few. With good public transport connections, you can get to Uppsala University in just a couple of minutes, and the same of course also applies to the popular student nations. If you need to travel further, you can walk to the Uppsala Travel Center in just under 10 minutes and then it's off, with whatever method of travel and direction you choose. To the south, Arlanda and Stockholm are easily accessible by train, bus and car. West of Uppsala, you can easily reach Enköping and Västerås with direct buses. With Upptåget you get quickly to Gävle and its intermediate stations. If you want to feel the pulse of the city, it is just as close to Uppsala's city centre. Here you can experience everything from shopping, restaurants, entertainment and various cultural events. Perhaps you prefer a more leisurely pace and would rather enjoy a walk or a moment's rest on a park bench. Lush green areas and parks are literally just around the corner. description: THE APARTMENTS: The size of the apartments varies between 1 to 4 rooms and a kitchen, so there is room for both the small and the larger family. A well-thought-out floor plan has placed the social areas with the open kitchen and living room facing the street, while the more private part with bedrooms faces the quieter courtyard. There are several places here where you can enjoy both relaxing and social moments. Cozy up with a good book on your own balcony/patio, mingle with friends in the communal courtyard or greet family and friends in the green front gardens. All the homes in the white house have balconies or patios on the ground level. In the yellow house, there will instead be a loft corridor that runs along the house wall. The common courtyard is south-facing to capture both the morning and afternoon sun. With large patios, lots of greenery and good opportunities for playing and socializing, the farm becomes a social place for the tenants. Between the street and the houses, the green front gardens grow, giving a cozy and inviting feeling. In the white house, all apartments have a balcony or private patio on the ground floor, while the yellow Kronhuset does not have balconies, but charming loft passages towards the sunny courtyard. THE FARM: The farm environment contains several meeting places, lush vegetation and open grassy areas. Through its middle runs a central lane with connected gathering places of wooden terraces and smaller pergolas. A larger gazebo with a long table and barbecue is located in the middle of the yard, as well as a framed playground. Vegetation in several layers with changing characters throughout the year provides protection for private patios. At the edge of the yard is a pearl ribbon of rain gardens connected by gutters framed by a variety of shrubs and trees.
area_description: THE NEARBY AREA: Barely two kilometers from the city centre, Uppsala's newest area is emerging, with Fyrislundsgatan as the main street. Here the focus will be on the variation between buildings with innovative architecture and verdant parks. There are both Årstaparken and Källparken here, but more new parks will be built. In the location between Salabacke and Årsta, there is proximity to both Gränby Centrum's large shopping mall and Årsta centre. COMMUNICATION: Uppsala city center is within easy cycling distance and public transport is also close at hand. In Östra Sala hill, it should feel natural and easy to move around in an environmentally friendly way. The goal is for Östra Sala hill to become one of Sweden's most bicycle-dense areas. Today, four bus routes operate Sala backe and Årsta 4, 7, 9 and 41. Östra Sala backe is to be adapted to an expanded trunk line network with fast public transport routes and attractive stop locations. SCHOOLS AND PRESCHOOLS: The area is close to both schools and preschools in Salabacke and Årsta. A new care home is also being built in the area, which houses 6 wards with a preschool. SERVICE: In just 5 minutes' walk you can shop among a large selection of shops, and services of all kinds in Gränbystaden. There is everything you can think of, such as large grocery stores, a gym, an activity arena and 25 restaurants and cafes. About as close is the center of Årsta. Here, in addition to shops, pharmacies, restaurants and various service companies, you will also find one of Uppsala County's county council's largest healthcare centers and the Public Dental Service. Årsta Church is also in Årsta Centrum with church activities and children's and youth activities. NATURE AND LEISURE TIME: Källparken is a district park in Sala hill. It was named after the Trinity Spring located on the site. People of all ages gather here and pedestrians and cyclists pass the park daily. The park is green and lush and boasts its own amphitheater. Årstaparken is a typical neighborhood park from the 1970s with groves and large open grassy areas for play and sports. A nice running loop runs around the entire park. Both Källparken and Årstaparken will be equipped and developed. New neighborhood park and park paths/areas will meet the need for recreational areas and better connect existing parks and green areas. Vaksala rectory garden in front of Vaksala church may be developed with, among other things, walking areas.

With good public transport connections, you can get to Uppsala University in just a couple of minutes, and the same of course also applies to the popular student nations. If you need to travel further, you can walk to the Uppsala Travel Center in just under 10 minutes and then it's off, with whatever method of travel and direction you choose. To the south, Arlanda and Stockholm are easily accessible by train, bus and car. West of Uppsala, you can easily reach Enköping and Västerås with direct buses. With Upptåget you get quickly to Gävle and its intermediate stations. If you want to feel the pulse of the city, it is just as close to Uppsala's city centre. Here you can experience everything from shopping, restaurants, entertainment and various cultural events. Perhaps you prefer a more leisurely pace and would rather enjoy a walk or a moment's rest on a park bench. Lush green areas and parks are literally just around the corner. The Segerdal neighborhood will become Knivsta's new heart in the city center and form the puzzle piece that links the new sawmill square with Knivsta's older, smaller-scale center. From having been a small station community, which then became an industrial community and then a commuter community, Knivsta will now develop into a small town with its own attractiveness. Until 2025, the municipality's vision is for the population to increase from today's roughly 18,000 to 25,000 inhabitants.

In Fruängen 2 there are 103 surface-efficient rental apartments with a high standard. Green yard with space for personal meetings and socializing. In the family-friendly surroundings, Fruängen's homes blend in nicely. The houses frame the neighborhood and give a cozy feeling at home. Good walking and cycling paths mean that children can safely walk or cycle to their friends in the area. There is also a preschool in the neighborhood and several preschools and schools are in the immediate area. Nature is knocking on the doorstep with excellent playgrounds to explore for the smaller and lovely trails to discover for both young and old. The facades are plastered and the roofs equipped with energy-giving solar cells. There are excellent apartments here, both for you who live alone, and for those of you who are two or more. The apartments have a fine standard with a well-thought-out floor plan where the white walls and the durable oak parquet are the consistent theme. In the kitchen there is a combined fridge/freezer, stove with hob and dishwasher. The fully tiled bathroom in white is furnished with a shower, washing machine and dryer or combi machine. The common courtyard creates great conditions for socializing. The adjacent playground with swings, playhouse, slide and climbing frame can also become a favorite place for many. This home has two nice patios that belong to the apartment. The rent includes heating, cold water and basic digital services from Tele2. Hot water and electricity are billed according to consumption. On the farm, there are outdoor parking spaces with or without charging stations, which are rented out by Hemvist management.
area_description: From the door, you have 30 meters to the nearest preschool, 50 meters to forest walks, 150 meters to the nearest school, 500 meters to the Travel Center, 700 meters to a larger grocery store and 2 km to central Enköping. From Resecentrum you can easily get to larger cities such as Stockholm, Uppsala and Västerås in just 50 minutes by train. If you drive, you are quickly on the E18 for further travel in any direction.

In the hall there is a tiled floor. The bathrooms are fully tiled and the larger apartments are equipped with a separate washing machine and dryer, in smaller apartments there is a combi machine. All kitchens are equipped with a dishwasher, oven and induction hob. All appliances are stainless steel. As part of our environmental work, we will have individual measurement of hot and cold water, and you pay for your own consumption. Adjacent to the property are parking facilities for residents.

title: Kansliskrivargatan 2
description: Cooperative tenancy to members The apartment is let with cooperative tenancy, which means that the housing applicant who is offered the apartment must sign up for membership before signing the contract and pay a letting deposit. The size of the rental investment is stated in the requirements for the apartment and it is refunded when you move out of the apartment. The rent will be increased from January 2025. Bostaden SKB's apartments in the Docenten quarter have ash parquet throughout, brightly painted walls, white interior doors, floor plinths and lining, while the window sills in natural stone are in the grey-brown scale. The kitchens have warm gray shutters from Vedum, laminate worktops and a stainless steel sink. Cooker with induction hob and convection oven from Electrolux as well as fridge and freezer (3-6 burners) or combined fridge/freezer (1-2 burners). Outlets for microwave ovens are available as well as prepared with connections for floor dishwashers. In the bathrooms, the walls are covered with white tiles and the floor is warm gray tiles. Shower with shower curtain rail is standard. In the bathroom, it is prepared if you want to plug in your own combi machine or a separate washing machine and dryer. (There are exceptions, see the apartment drawing). Most apartments have a balcony or patio. The apartment is equipped with a security door. There are newspaper racks by the front door and mailboxes in the property's light and airy entrance. Here you can go on a virtual tour of an apartment and see an example of an apartment in the neighborhood Virtual apartment tour Docent SKB. The apartment is connected to the Internet via Telia fiber (100/100). Wifi router included. Internet is included in the rent. Sustainable living In Docenten, it is easy to live environmentally friendly. The roofs are covered with sedum and solar cells have been installed that generate electricity for the apartments. Energy is also recovered from the water that comes from bathrooms and kitchens. The washrooms are environmentally friendly, equipped with deionized water. For those who like to get around on two wheels, there is a generous bicycle garage with a washing area and convenient entrance from the street. As a resident of SKB, you yourself are responsible for painting and wallpapering in the apartment, either with your own funds or through the fund linked to the apartment. The association is responsible for floors, replacement of white goods and sanitary ware. Community Living in a cooperative tenancy means an opportunity to influence residents and the association. In all SKB properties there is a neighborhood council made up of resident members. The neighborhood council is responsible for the common room that residents can book.
area_description: In Rosendal, you don't have to choose between living close to services or living close to nature. Here you get both. The district is framed by two of Uppsala's green nature reserves, Kronparken and Stadsskogen. In addition to the proximity to green areas, most of what you need for a comfortable everyday life is nearby. Here there are several preschools and schools to choose from, well-stocked grocery stores, restaurants, other local services and a large selection for those who like to move around. Everything from a gym, basketball court, padel and tennis courts to popular play areas for both young and old. You can get to the center of Uppsala in 10-12 minutes by bus or bicycle. Possibility to rent a garage in the neighborhood.

title: Västgötaresan 56 A
description: In the heart of Sävja, Trähuset is emerging - a climate-smart residence built entirely in wood, next door to the Lunsen nature reserve and with services such as a grocery store, pharmacy and schools within easy reach. The property is certified according to Miljöbyggnad Silver and NollCO2, has solar cells for its own electricity and recycled windows. Here you live in a bright and well-planned apartment with parquet floors, white-painted walls and a stylish kitchen from Noblessa equipped with a dishwasher. The bathroom is fully tiled and prepared for a washing machine. Courtyard, bicycle room and modern laundry room make everyday life comfortable. Sustainable housing - for you and the future. Parking spaces on ground level. A parking space can be searched after signing a rental agreement. Charging points will be available.
area_description: The district of Sävja is an established district in the southern parts of Uppsala. The wooden house is a welcome addition to new rental housing in the grown-up environment. Most of the services you need in everyday life can be found in the immediate area. You will find a larger selection with, among other things, a large grocery store, interior design stores, system companies and Ikea in the nearby district of Boländerna. Lockar city has wide and lighted footpaths and cycle paths for those who like to get there on foot or by bicycle. If you want to go by public transport, there is a bus stop right outside the door with frequent bus trips to the city and the travel centre. In addition, there are plans for a future tramway through the area. With the car, you can quickly get out on the E4 for travel in different directions. If you like being out in nature, take your dog, a family member or a group of friends with you and recharge your energy in the forest right next door. For those who like to work up a sweat, there is an easily accessible outdoor gym at Sävja Idrottsplats. The nearby and popular Sunnerstabacken is an obvious place to hang out if you like mountain biking, skiing, snowboarding or sledding. It is also not far to Lake Ekoln for those who like swimming, sailing, fishing and, in the winter when the ice melts, ice skating.

title: Apoteksvägen 3C
description: Swan-labelled rental accommodation with 1 room and kitchen built in 2023. Well-planned and open floor plan with plenty of light. We have selected colors, materials and details that make it easy to create your own and personal feeling. The kitchens, which are in a green color, come from Vedum and are equipped with a dishwasher, oven and induction hob. All white goods come in stainless steel. The bathroom is equipped with a combined washing machine. White chest of drawers with a round LED mirror above. The apartment has a balcony facing west. In the Segerdal quarter, we have developed two different interior design concepts – one darker and one lighter – two styles, two types of home. In both design concepts, the basic materials are the same, but the color of the kitchen joinery and the tiles in the bathrooms differ. This apartment has the dark concept - Concept 1: In the dark interior concept, the kitchens are in a beautiful mist green tone with smooth doors and knobs in brushed chrome. Worktop and splash guard in durable laminate in a dark grey/black colour, which harmonizes with the gray shade of the kitchen. The bathrooms are fully tiled.
area_description: As a resident of Knivsta, you not only have the lovely nature as a neighbor, but also a very good starting point for commuting to work. The train between Stockholm and Uppsala stops in the middle of central Knivsta, and it takes 29 minutes to reach Stockholm Central and 9 minutes to the station in Uppsala. The Segerdal neighborhood will become Knivsta's new heart in the city center and form the puzzle piece that links the new sawmill square with Knivsta's older, smaller-scale center. From having been a small station community, which then became an industrial community and then a commuter community, Knivsta will now develop into a small town with its own attractiveness. Until 2025, the municipality's vision is for the population to increase from today's roughly 18,000 to 25,000 inhabitants.

title: Verkstadsvägen 12 B
description: Nice and newly built apartment in the middle of Örsundsbro. White painted walls and parquet floors. Bathroom with tiles and clinker, glass shower walls. Washing machine and dryer are in the apartment. Kitchen from the kitchen supplier Vedum with laminate worktop and bright doors. All homes in the project have either a balcony or patio. Parking is available next to the residence and is included. Fiber can be signed with Liden data.
area_description: The residences are located in the middle of Örsundsbro with ICA as the nearest neighbour. There are also good transport links nearby. Possibility of parking directly outside the residence. Within walking distance are pleasant Örsundaån and walking paths.

White-pigmented oak parquet throughout, light walls. Light gray kitchen from Vedum equipped with dishwasher, fridge, freezer, oven and induction hob. The bathroom has a shower and washing machine/dryer. There is also access to a shared laundry room. The property is equipped with solar cells and geothermal heating. Included in the rent: Heating and cold water, Telia TV package base and digital TV box. Not included in the rent: Housekeeping (the tenant signs their own subscription). Hot water (actual cost of consumption is charged in arrears). Broadband and telephony. The property includes a two-level garage with 144 parking spaces available for rent. Apartment number: I-1101
area_description: In the Ångloket neighborhood, you have walking distance to the center of Knivsta with shops, cafes, restaurants, culture, shopping, services, schools and care. At the same time, you live close to beautiful nature with mushroom forests and ski trails. The Upplandsleden also winds through the municipality, which offers varied hiking through forest and open fields. Knivsta also has a brilliant commuter location. Just a few minutes from your gate is Knivsta station and from here it only takes 8 minutes to Arlanda, 10 minutes to Uppsala and approx. 30 minutes to Stockholm C.

area_description: Together with Valsätra, Gottsunda forms the heart of southern Uppsala. Gottsunda is a place where the needs of both the younger and older generations are met. In the area you will find the center of Gottsunda with its cultural mall (https://www.gottsundacentrum.se/) but also a wide cultural life and forest environment with lovely walking paths. Here there are parks with activities for children and young people, cultural centers and shopping opportunities. In Gottsunda Center you will also find the popular Gottsundabadet (https://gottsundabadet.se/). By bus you get quickly and smoothly into Uppsala's city center and by bicycle as a means of transport you reach the water and the beautiful Vårdsätraviken in just 10 minutes.
