area_description: Kvarngärdet is a popular and close to the city residential area with proximity to everything. Here you will find grocery stores, gyms, parking garages and schools to name a few. With good public transport connections, you can get to Uppsala University in just a couple of minutes, and the same of course also applies to the popular student nations. If you need to travel further, you can walk to the Uppsala Travel Center in just under 10 minutes and then it's off, with whatever method of travel and direction you choose. To the south, Arlanda and Stockholm are easily accessible by train, bus and car. West of Uppsala, you can easily reach Enköping and Västerås with direct buses. With Upptåget you get quickly to Gävle and its intermediate stations. If you want to feel the pulse of the city, it is just as close to Uppsala's city centre. Here you can experience everything from shopping, restaurants, entertainment and various cultural events. Perhaps you prefer a more leisurely pace and would rather enjoy a walk or a moment's rest on a park bench. Lush green areas and parks are literally just around the corner. Not least Kapellgärdsparken, which really has something for everyone. Toboggan run, large open grass areas for picnics, park benches, a skateboard park and skate boule, playground and an outdoor gym. A very popular excursion destination for both adults and children, all year round. Everyone can find their favorite place here.

description: This well-planned second home in a property built in 2018 has an open floor plan and lovely light. From the balcony you have a view of the intimate courtyard designed by award-winning landscape architect Karavan. The apartment has bright painted walls and parquet floors throughout, except in the entrance where it is gray tiles. Living room: The kitchen has white cabinet doors, white tiles and a worktop in gray laminate. Prepared for dishwasher. Bathroom: White-tiled bathroom and gray tiled floor. Equipped with washing machine and tumble dryer. Balcony: Spacious and accessible from the family room. OTHER SPACES Storage: A storage room with mesh walls is in the basement. Laundry: There is no laundry in the block. Bicycle storage: Available on the basement level. The environmental room: Located next to Råbyvägen 50 and has sorting for combustibles, food waste, paper packaging, plastic, metal, newspapers, glass, batteries, light sources and electric cages. The rent is stated at the 2025 level and will be adjusted when the 2026 rent negotiations are completed.
area_description: Welcome to Råbyvägen in the Kapellgärdet district! Parking: Parking in the residence is not included. Vacant parking and garage spaces can be searched on Uppsalahem's website. read more about your area via the link: https://www.uppsalahem.se/0230

title: Almqvistgatan 2
description: Welcome to a bright and well-planned home with 2 rooms and a kitchen and a lovely balcony facing the courtyard! Already in the hall you are greeted by an inviting feeling with plenty of space for outerwear and shoes. The living room has a nice amount of light that creates a pleasant and homely atmosphere. The kitchen is practical and has room for a dining group. Here there is a fridge and freezer, oven, stove and cooker hood. It is also prepared for the dishwasher, which you can choose as an option. The storage options are good with an associated storage room in the stairwell and a cloakroom with entrance from the hall. The fully tiled bathroom is equipped with a shower, toilet and sink. It is also prepared for a washing machine and underfloor heating, which you can opt for if you wish. The apartment has a security door and the stairwell is equipped with an electronic access system and mailboxes on the entrance floor. You have access to a shared laundry room with easy electronic booking. - Electricity is not included in the rent and you pay for hot and cold water according to your own consumption. - A basic range of TV and internet via Telia (1 Mbit/s) is included, and if you want faster internet, you can easily order it via Z-market at rikshem.se. - You can search for a parking space and extra storage via minasidor.rikshem.se. The rent is based on the 2025 level and may change after negotiations for 2026. You can collect the keys from 14:00 on the move-in day. The apartment is rented as is, which means that some surfaces may be worn. The inspection report is available on My pages when the contract is active. You can order maintenance and options once the contract has started.
area_description: Welcome to Gränby, a lively neighborhood in northern Uppsala! Here you live close to both nature and city life. Gränbystaden is the heart of the area with over 140 shops, restaurants and services. For families with children, there are playgrounds with cable cars, climbing frames and sandboxes. For those who like to be active, there is a beach volleyball court, barbecue areas, large green areas and sports fields with tennis, padel, ice rink, athletics arena and soccer fields. Nearby is also a 4H farm with animals and activities for children. The area has several preschools and schools, including Liljeforsskolan and Gränbyskolan. You can easily get around by bicycle on nice walking and cycling paths, or by bus that leaves right outside. By car you can quickly reach the E4. Gränby is constantly developing. Future plans include a new swimming pool, high school with a sports profile and a fast cycle track that will connect the sports field with the city center. Gränby has something for everyone. Welcome to enjoy yourself!

area_description: The neighborhood that is emerging in Lillsidan will blend nicely into the cityscape, and you who move in will have a well-planned home with a nice view of the city. The houses in Westerlunden are built to pass Miljöbyggnad Silver, which means a healthy indoor environment, low climate impact and sustainable choice of materials. In Lillsidan, a fine mix of tenements, condominiums and townhouses in various forms together with preschools, nursing homes and commerce will replace the former industrial and business area. As a resident of Westerlunden, you can easily reach everything you need, whether you move around on foot, by bike or by bus. If you commute, it is not far to the station and by car you can reach the 55 and E18. An excellent home ground for both small and large. The southern block consists of 137 well-planned rental units, ranging from well-planned one-bedroom apartments to family-friendly four-bedroom apartments. There is also a well-stocked ICA store and pharmacy in the area. We call that proximity everyday luxury! Parking spaces are available for rent, there may be a queue.

In Alsike there is a grocery store, pizzeria, gym, exercise track, mountain bike course, playgrounds and padel courts. In addition, there are fine forest areas excellent for berry and mushroom picking or walking. Knivsta has a large selection for those who like outdoor life, sports and exercise. To name a few gems, both Lake Mälaren and Lake Valloxen offer nice swimming spots, and Morga Hage and Gredelby Hage are two nature reserves excellent for excursions, picnics or adventures. There are a total of 12 space-efficient apartments consisting of one and three bedroom apartments with well-thought-out floor plans and lightly furnished rooms. The houses are supplied with geothermal heat and heat recovery to have as low a climate footprint as possible. The residences are tastefully planned with brightly painted walls, oak laminate floors throughout and fully equipped kitchens from Ballingslöv with dishwasher and induction hob. In the bathrooms, the walls are tiled, the floors are tiled and the shower walls are glass. In addition, all bathrooms are equipped with a combined washing machine/dryer. The larger homes have a large loft with a spacious bedroom and family room. If you want to relax or spend time with loved ones, the communal garden in a cozy south-west location can be a nice alternative.
area_description: About Bergkullen Bergkullen in southern Knivsta is a small-scale, climate-smart and pleasant accommodation. Here, Tantalos Fastigheter manages 12 modern and well-planned homes. An idyll for those who want to live close to nature, but still only have 1.5 km to the center of Knivsta. The basis of the project is to be able to offer a home at a low cost and still live comfortably, close and sustainably. Bergkullen is close to nature in the southern parts of Knivsta. Here you live secluded and close at the same time, which gives a familiar and pleasant feeling. Directly around the knot, the forest spreads out and within walking distance is Lake Valloxen, which in the summer is filled with happy bathers and in the winter, when the ice melts, with skating enthusiasts. You can walk to the nearest grocery store in a few minutes and there are several preschools and schools to choose from in the immediate area. For those who like to exercise, there are two large sports halls nearby as well as a gym, swimming pool and padel courts. The excellent location with proximity to the station means that many choose to live in Knivsta and commute to work in a larger town nearby. The train takes about 11 minutes to Uppsala and 30 minutes to Stockholm. Welcome to Bergkullen in Knivsta!

title: Fyrislundsgatan 39 A
description: THE APARTMENTS: The size of the apartments varies between 1 to 4 rooms and a kitchen, so there is room for both the small and the larger family. A well-thought-out floor plan has placed the social areas with the open kitchen and living room facing the street, while the more private part with bedrooms faces the quieter courtyard. There are several places here where you can enjoy both relaxing and social moments. Cozy up with a good book on your own balcony/patio, mingle with friends in the communal courtyard or greet family and friends in the green front gardens. All the homes in the white house have balconies or patios on the ground level. In the yellow house, there will instead be a loft corridor that runs along the house wall. The common courtyard is south-facing to capture both the morning and afternoon sun. With large patios, lots of greenery and good opportunities for playing and socializing, the farm becomes a social place for the tenants. Between the street and the houses, the green front gardens grow, giving a cozy and inviting feeling. In the white house, all apartments have a balcony or private patio on the ground floor, while the yellow Kronhuset does not have balconies, but charming loft passages towards the sunny courtyard. THE FARM: The farm environment contains several meeting places, lush vegetation and open grassy areas. Through its middle runs a central lane with connected gathering places of wooden terraces and smaller pergolas. A larger gazebo with a long table and barbecue is located in the middle of the yard, as well as a framed playground. Vegetation in several layers with changing characters throughout the year provides protection for private patios. At the edge of the yard is a pearl ribbon of rain gardens connected by gutters framed by a variety of shrubs and trees.
area_description: THE NEARBY AREA: Barely two kilometers from the city centre, Uppsala's newest area is emerging, with Fyrislundsgatan as the main street. Here the focus will be on the variation between buildings with innovative architecture and verdant parks. There are both Årstaparken and Källparken here, but more new parks will be built. In the location between Salabacke and Årsta, there is proximity to both Gränby Centrum's large shopping mall and Årsta centre. COMMUNICATION: Uppsala city center is within easy cycling distance and public transport is also close at hand. In Östra Sala hill, it should feel natural and easy to move around in an environmentally friendly way. The goal is for Östra Sala hill to become one of Sweden's most bicycle-dense areas. Today, four bus routes operate Sala backe and Årsta 4, 7, 9 and 41. Östra Sala backe is to be adapted to an expanded trunk line network with fast public transport routes and attractive stop locations. SCHOOLS AND PRESCHOOLS: The area is close to both schools and preschools in Salabacke and Årsta. A new care home is also being built in the area, which houses 6 wards with a preschool. SERVICE: In just 5 minutes' walk you can shop among a large selection of shops, and services of all kinds in Gränbystaden. There is everything you can think of, such as large grocery stores, a gym, an activity arena and 25 restaurants and cafes. About as close is the center of Årsta. Here, in addition to shops, pharmacies, restaurants and various service companies, you will also find one of Uppsala County's county council's largest healthcare centers and the Public Dental Service. Årsta Church is also in Årsta Centrum with church activities and children's and youth activities. NATURE AND LEISURE TIME: Källparken is a district park in Sala hill. It was named after the Trinity Spring located on the site. People of all ages gather here and pedestrians and cyclists pass the park daily. The park is green and lush and boasts its own amphitheater. Årstaparken is a typical neighborhood park from the 1970s with groves and large open grassy areas for play and sports. A nice running loop runs around the entire park. Both Källparken and Årstaparken will be equipped and developed. New neighborhood park and park paths/areas will meet the need for recreational areas and better connect existing parks and green areas. Vaksala rectory garden in front of Vaksala church may be developed with, among other things, walking areas.

description: In central Knivsta, 24 minutes to Stockholm, you will find this well-planned apartment. Modernly designed with an open plan between kitchen and living room. White-pigmented oak parquet throughout, light walls. Light gray kitchen from Vedum equipped with dishwasher, fridge, freezer, oven and induction hob. The bathroom has a shower and a combined washing machine/dryer. The property also has access to a shared laundry room. The property is equipped with solar cells and geothermal heating. Included in the rent: Heating and cold water, Telia TV package base and digital TV box. Not included in the rent: Housekeeping (the tenant signs their own subscription). Hot water (actual cost of consumption is charged in arrears). Broadband and telephony. The property includes a two-level garage with 144 parking spaces.
area_description: In the Ångloket neighborhood, you have walking distance to the center of Knivsta with shops, cafes, restaurants, culture, shopping, services, schools and care. At the same time, you live close to beautiful nature with mushroom forests and ski trails. The Upplandsleden also winds through the municipality, which offers varied hiking through forest and open fields. Knivsta also has a brilliant commuter location. Just a few minutes from your gate is Knivsta station and from here it only takes 8 minutes to Arlanda, 10 minutes to Uppsala and approx. 30 minutes to Stockholm C.

title: Flädergatan 10
description: The materials in the apartments have been selected to be durable, functional and easy to maintain. And so that you can easily feel at home. Oak parquet throughout and light walls are classic and work with almost everything. The kitchen has white, smooth doors and is equipped with a glass ceramic hob, convection oven, fridge and freezer or combined fridge/freezer and dishwasher. It is also prepared for the microwave. In the fully tiled bathrooms there is a washing machine and tumble dryer, alternatively a combi machine. All apartments have a balcony (ordinary, French or Spanish) or patio.
area_description: The neighborhood that is emerging in Lillsidan will blend nicely into the cityscape, and you who move in will have a well-planned home with a nice view of the city. The houses in Westerlunden are built to pass Miljöbyggnad Silver, which means a healthy indoor environment, low climate impact and sustainable choice of materials. In Lillsidan, a fine mix of tenements, condominiums and townhouses in various forms together with preschools, nursing homes and commerce will replace the former industrial and business area. As a resident of Westerlunden, you can easily reach everything you need, whether you move around on foot, by bike or by bus. If you commute, it is not far to the station and by car you can reach the 55 and E18. An excellent home ground for both small and large. The southern block consists of 137 well-planned rental properties, ranging from one-bedroom apartments to family-friendly four-bedroom apartments. There is also a well-stocked ICA store and pharmacy in the area. We call that proximity everyday luxury! Parking spaces are available for rent, there may be a queue.

title: Almqvistgatan 18

When you step in, you are greeted by a welcoming hall with plenty of space for hanging out. The living room offers a nice amount of light that creates a pleasant atmosphere. The kitchen has room for a dining group and is equipped with a fridge/freezer, oven, stove and cooker hood. It is also prepared for the dishwasher, which you can choose as an option. The storage possibilities are good with an associated storage room and a cloakroom with entrance from the hall. The fully tiled bathroom is equipped with a sink, toilet and shower and is prepared for a washing machine and floor heating, which you can choose as an option. The residence has a security door and the stairwell is equipped with an electronic access system and mailboxes on the entrance floor. You also have access to a shared laundry room with electronic booking. This apartment offers everything you need for a comfortable stay. Welcome home! Good to know: - Electricity is not included in the rent. - You pay for hot and cold water according to your own consumption. - A basic range of TV and internet (1 Mbit/s) via Telia is included. If you want faster internet, you can order via Z-market yourself: rikshem.se/bredband-tv - You are looking for a parking space and extra storage via: minasidor.rikshem.se The rent is based on the 2025 level and can be changed after the 2026 negotiations. You can pick up the keys from 14:00 on the move-in day. The apartment is rented as is, which means that some surfaces may be worn. Inspection records are available on My pages when the contract is active. You can order maintenance and options once the contract has started.
area_description: Welcome to Gränby, a charming district in northern Uppsala! Here you can find everything you need for a comfortable and active lifestyle. Gränbystaden is the heart of the area with over 140 shops, restaurants and service units. For a green oasis, visit Gränbyparken, where you will find playgrounds with cable cars, climbing frames, swings and sandboxes for the little ones. For the active, there is a beach volleyball court, barbecue areas and picnic tables, as well as large green spaces for walking and running. At Gränby sports field there is a colony area, tennis and padel hall, ice rink, athletics arena and soccer fields. Nearby is also a 4H farm with animals and activities for children. The area has several preschools and schools, including Liljeforsskolan and Gränbyskolan. For those who cycle, there are nice footpaths and cycle paths. If you prefer public transport, the bus runs conveniently right outside the door. By car you can quickly reach the E4 for journeys in different directions. Future plans for Gränby include a new swimming pool, a high school with a sports profile and a fast cycle track that will connect the Gränby sports field with the center of Uppsala. Gränby has something for everyone. Welcome to discover everything the district has to offer!

title: Marknadgatan 18

Here you are greeted by a welcoming hall with a black/grey floor, white painted walls and white wardrobes. The apartment's bright kitchen from Vedum has lacquered white doors, a worktop in light gray mineral-patterned laminate and fittings in stainless steel. The kitchen is also equipped with a dishwasher. The walls are painted white and the floor is matt-lacquered 3-strip oak parquet. The generous windows have windowsills in beautiful natural stone and the stylish bathroom has tiled floors in black/grey tones, white tiled walls, a white chest of drawers and a stainless steel faucet. The bathroom is equipped with a combined washer and dryer from the Cylinda brand.
area_description: About Gränbystaden Gränbystaden, Uppsala's second city center continues to grow and develop. Here you can find everything from shopping, restaurants and cafes to good public transport, service, housing and proximity to green areas and parks. If the inner city attracts you, you can pedal there in less than a quarter of an hour or you can hop on one of the buses that easily take you into the city.

Here you are within walking distance to preschool, school, swimming pool, shops, restaurants and commuter train to Uppsala or Gävle. The journey time to Uppsala C is 26 minutes and during the day the trains run with a half-hourly service. 100 meters from the house is Kvarnparken with a playground, toboggan run, outdoor gym and barbecue area. There are a total of four newly built two-family houses on the property, and in a later stage six smaller single-storey houses will be built. The two-dwelling houses' roofs are covered with solar panels that provide environmentally friendly electricity to the energy-efficient homes. In the common storage room, you can borrow equipment for gardening but also tables and benches when it's time for a party.

area_description: Kvarngärdet is a popular and close to the city residential area with proximity to everything. Here you will find grocery stores, gyms, parking garages and schools to name a few. With good public transport connections, you can get to Uppsala University in just a couple of minutes, and the same of course also applies to the popular student nations. If you need to travel further, you can walk to the Uppsala Travel Center in just under 10 minutes and then it's off, with whatever method of travel and direction you choose. To the south, Arlanda and Stockholm are easily accessible by train, bus and car. West of Uppsala, you can easily reach Enköping and Västerås with direct buses. With Upptåget you get quickly to Gävle and its intermediate stations. If you want to feel the pulse of the city, it is just as close to Uppsala's city centre. Here you can experience everything from shopping, restaurants, entertainment and various cultural events. Perhaps you prefer a more leisurely pace and would rather enjoy a walk or a moment's rest on a park bench. Lush green areas and parks are literally just around the corner. Not least Kapellgärdsparken, which really has something for everyone. Toboggan run, large open grass areas for picnics, park benches, a skateboard park and skate boule, playground and an outdoor gym. A very popular excursion destination for both adults and children, all year round. Everyone can find their favorite place here.

There are good pedestrian and cycle path connections. There is a bus stop for the city bus nearby. For those with a car, it is possible to supplement with your own parking space via EHB's separate queue for parking spaces. TV, internet and telephony via fibre. The rent currently includes approximately 15 TV channels and internet with 0.5 Mbit/s. Telephony is not included in the rent. The telephone is connected to the broadband socket, there is no telephone jack in the home. You have the opportunity to order your own services for television, internet and telephony from a number of suppliers via the GlobalConnect portal. You pay for what you order yourself and are not included in the rent. Heating of the home via district heating is included in the rent. During the hottest days of summer, the indoor temperature is lowered centrally via the ventilation to create a more even and pleasant indoor environment. You sign your own electricity contract and can freely choose between companies and energy sources. area_description: EHB's sheltered housing in Romberga gives you the opportunity for a comfortable everyday life with community and activities! In addition to your own home, you get access to common spaces for socializing, activities and wonderful outdoor environments. In the large, quiet courtyard, you can sit and enjoy the greenery, socialize and get active. In the area there is also a bowling alley, a municipal park and a colony area. You also get proximity to Fagerskogen with electrically lit exercise tracks and ski tracks in the winter. Directly adjacent to the sheltered housing is a café with a larger common room. There are also several smaller common rooms that can be booked. Staff are available at certain times and the activities are designed together with the tenants. To make it easier for you to visit common areas and neighbors, the property is designed so that you can walk through the entire property without having to go outside. Doors in public areas open electronically and there is a lift. In Romberga, you also live close to the large shopping center in the Myran area, where you will find several shops, restaurants, gyms and services!

title: Gredelbyvägen 1C
description: Nordic Ecolabelled rental properties in varying sizes from 1 to 5 rooms and kitchen. Regardless of whether you want to live alone, are cohabiting or about to start a family, here you will find accommodation that suits you. Well-planned and open floor plans with plenty of light. We have selected colors, materials and details that make it easy to create your own and personal feeling. The kitchens, which come in a green or beige color, come from Vedum and are equipped with a dishwasher, oven and induction hob. All white goods come in stainless steel. The larger bathrooms are equipped with a separate washing machine and dryer, and the smaller apartments with a combined washing machine. White chest of drawers with a round LED mirror above. The single-sided apartments facing the yard have a French balcony, apartments from ground floor to floor 4 have a balcony or patio. Located in stairwell 5, there is a shared roof terrace available to all residents
area_description: As a resident of Knivsta, you not only have the lovely nature as a neighbor, but also a very good starting point for commuting to work. The train between Stockholm and Uppsala stops in the middle of central Knivsta, and it takes 29 minutes to reach Stockholm Central and 9 minutes to the station in Uppsala. The Segerdal neighborhood will become Knivsta's new heart in the city center and form the puzzle piece that links the new sawmill square with Knivsta's older, smaller-scale center. From having been a small station community, which then became an industrial community and then a commuter community, Knivsta will now develop into a small town with its own attractiveness. Until 2025, the municipality's vision is for the population to increase from today's roughly 18,000 to 25,000 inhabitants.

title: Forsbyvägen 3
description: 3 rooms and kitchen in popular Knivsta! Now you can move into this apartment, which has undergone an extensive renovation in 2025. The floor plan of the home is well thought out and the apartment has a nice amount of light. The renovation includes a new kitchen, new bathroom, new floors and freshly painted walls. The apartment has white-painted walls and parquet floors throughout. The kitchen interior is white and has a quartz composite top above the sink. The kitchen is also equipped with a stove with ceramic hob, fridge/freezer and dishwasher. The bathroom has fully tiled walls in white and gray tiles on the floor. The bathroom has a shower with a shower wall, underfloor heating and a heated towel rail. The apartment is also prepared for a washing machine and dryer. - This is the first apartment to be rented out after the renovation, so minor deviations from the description may occur. - Security door - Mailboxes in entrance level - Floor plan: Some deviation may occur, and the floor plan may be mirrored. - The apartment includes a storage room. The storage room is located in the attic. - The laundry room is in the building and has a digital booking system. The tenant can pick up his keys to the apartment and the property from 14.00 on the day the apartment is to be occupied. When the day of access falls on a holiday, the following weekday applies according to the Tenancy Act. At the conclusion of the agreement, cold and hot water is included in the rent. However, this apartment is prepared for individual water metering and billing (IMD) of hot water. In the event that the Landlord should decide to introduce individual billing for hot water, part of the rent level will be waived. The rent is based on the 2025 level and can be adjusted after future rent negotiations. Options can be ordered once the contract has entered into force.
area_description: In Knivsta you can enjoy the advantages of the urban area with good service. Here you live within walking distance to the center of Knivsta with its range of shops and restaurants. Here you also have all the general services you need in everyday life, such as a health centre. For families with children, there is a range of preschools and primary schools. At the same time, you are close to the tranquility and seclusion of the countryside. Nearby you have many nice walking areas and excursion destinations nearby. Public transport to and from Knivsta is well developed and both train and bus connections to the city are fast. It doesn't take long to commute to either Stockholm or Uppsala. The train to Stockholm takes 30 minutes, to Uppsala 10 minutes and the train to Arlanda takes 8 minutes.

title: Herrgårdsgatan 9
description: The apartments have modern kitchens from Marbodal with white kitchen doors. The kitchens are equipped with fridge/freezer from Electrolux and stove with oven. Splash guard and countertop in laminate with the appearance of gray concrete. White-pigmented and matte-lacquered 3-strip ash parquet floor throughout living room, bedroom, kitchen and hallway. All rooms have white painted walls and white interior doors. The living room and bedroom have windowsills in gray natural stone. The bathroom is fully tiled in matt white tiles 20x40 mm and gray tiled floor 20x20. Shower area and combined washing machine and dryer. Smoking is prohibited in the entire property, which means that smoking may not take place in the apartment, in the property's public areas or on balconies/patios/attic passages. The smoking ban extends 25 meters from the body of the house.
area_description: As a resident of Stationslunden, you are close to everything you need to put together the everyday puzzle. Only 900 meters away is Bålsta Centrum, where everything from grocery stores, restaurants, pharmacies, health centers and well-established communications are available. Bålsta station is also within walking distance, where it only takes 40 minutes to Stockholm Central.

title: Torpängsgatan 19
description: In central Knivsta, 24 minutes to Stockholm, you will find this well-planned apartment. Modernly designed with an open plan between kitchen and living room. White-pigmented oak parquet throughout, light walls. Light gray kitchen from Vedum equipped with dishwasher, fridge, freezer, oven and induction hob. The bathroom has a shower and a combined washing machine/dryer. There is also access to a shared laundry room. The property is equipped with solar cells and geothermal heating. Included in the rent: Heating and cold water, Telia TV package base and digital TV box. Not included in the rent: Housekeeping (the tenant signs their own subscription). Hot water (actual cost of consumption is charged in arrears). Broadband and telephony. The property includes a two-level garage with 144 parking spaces available for rent. Apartment number: H-1402
area_description: In the Ångloket neighborhood, you have walking distance to the center of Knivsta with shops, cafes, restaurants, culture, shopping, services, schools and care. At the same time, you live close to beautiful nature with mushroom forests and ski trails. The Upplandsleden also winds through the municipality, which offers varied hiking through forest and open fields. Knivsta also has a brilliant commuter location. Just a few minutes from your gate is Knivsta station and from here it only takes 8 minutes to Arlanda, 10 minutes to Uppsala and approx. 30 minutes to Stockholm C.

title: Svinnegarnsvägen 2A
description: Flexible move-in - Choose a date between the day of contract writing and 3 calendar months ahead. In addition to your home, you also get access to several common areas, a gym and a lovely courtyard with a barbecue. Your landlord is also on site at certain times during the weeks. Together with you and your neighbors, we organize meetings and activities based on your interests and wishes! The home is newly created through remodeling and has a new kitchen, bathroom and new surface layers in the living areas. The home has great opportunities to furnish to your liking and needs. Bedroom with storage option with space-saving sliding doors. Kitchen with dining area. Beige painted kitchen doors and laminate worktop with a light slate texture. The kitchen is prepared for the installation of its own dishwasher. The bathroom is fully tiled with white tiles on the walls and light gray tiles on the floor. Shower with support handle mounted on wall and rod for shower curtain. Towel dryer. Hall equipped with hat shelf and storage with space-saving sliding doors. All walls in the home are painted white. All floors in living areas have a single-strip parquet design carpet that mimics rustic, light brown cedar wood. The carpet is easy to care for, wear-resistant and has sound-absorbing properties. The residence is located in house A. Between house A and house C there is an internal passage. Doors in public areas open electronically and there is a lift to all floors. The common laundry room, the room, the social room and the gym are in building A. A common storage room for parking and charging permobiles is in building A, depending on space. Apartment storage for storage is available in building A or B. TV, internet and telephony via fibre. The rent currently includes approximately 15 TV channels and internet with 0.5 Mbit/s. Telephony is not included in the rent. TV, internet and telephone are connected to the broadband socket, there is no antenna socket or telephone jack in the home. You have the opportunity to order your own services for television, internet and telephony from a number of suppliers via Global Connect. You pay for what you order yourself and are not included in the rent. Heating of the home is included in the rent. Your consumption of hot water is not included in the rent. Your consumption of household electricity is not included in the rent. You sign your own electricity contract and can freely choose between companies and energy sources. The accommodation does not offer its own nursing services, but this does not exclude the possibility that you have such services through other companies. The property and all sheltered housing must be smoke-free both inside and outside.
area_description: Hummelsta is a quiet, pleasant place about 8 km west of Enköping and about 25 kilometers east of Västerås. EHB's sheltered housing is centrally located in the community at Svinnegarnsvägen 2. Nearby there are, among other things, a preschool, school, sports hall, bus stop, church center, pizzeria, parcel boxes and the Borgvallen sports ground. There is good public transport to and from Hummelsta and the bus stops are close to the sheltered housing. It takes about 10 minutes by bus to the center of Enköping and 17 minutes to the station and about 30 minutes by bus to Västerås station. There is also a cycle path all the way to Enköping along the old E18. The cycle path is separated from the carriageway by a balustrade. Car spaces are provided via EHB's separate queue for car spaces. There are 22 parking spaces, of which 3 are disabled parking spaces. There are also two visitor parking spaces that are combined with charging points for electric cars. Parking in visitor parking and any electric car charging is paid via an app.

title: Fannalundsvägen 12
description: If you are interested in looking for the home, you can book a viewing by contacting EHB on phone number 0171-625820. As of September 1, 2024, we are introducing a discount of SEK 600 per month for young people who live in or move to Bahcostaden's youth housing. The discount is given up to and including the month before the tenant turns 29 for a maximum of 4 years. The discount can only be used once per tenant and household. The discount is automatically deducted from the rental fee and reported separately on the invoice. The youth housing consists of one or two rooms and a kitchen. They are simply and stylishly planned, which means that you can advantageously put your own stamp on your home. All youth housing has white painted walls and fully tiled bathrooms with plastic carpet on the floor. The bathrooms are prepared for easy installation of own washing equipment. Fiber is included and you choose for yourself whether you want to add services offered by several providers via GlobalConnect. The rent includes 0.5 Mbit/s data and currently around 15 TV channels in the analogue network. Housekeeping and actual own hot water consumption are added to the rent. Cold water and heating of the home via district heating are included in the rent. Good storage facilities are offered in the form of a separate cellar and a common laundry room is available on the ground floor. There are good pedestrian and cycle path connections and a nearby bus stop. For those with a car, it is possible to supplement with your own parking space via EHB's separate queue for parking spaces. There are parking spaces with charging points for electric cars. The property and all dwellings must be smoke-free both inside and outside. The images are sample images from the residential area and a home with the same layout as the home that is conveyed with the difference that they are on different floors.
area_description: THE BEST LOCATION FOR A PRACTICAL, SOCIAL & ACTIVE LIFE! The center, grocery stores, preschool, school, gymnasium, sports, swimming, tennis, padel and ice rink, golf course, green areas and several of Enköping's beautiful parks are within about 1.5 km, so here you get the best conditions for a practical as well as social and active life! In addition, it is only about 1.4 km to the travel center, which is Enköping's hub for public travel. With SJ you get to Stockholm's central station in about 40 minutes, or why not go about 12 minutes to connect to SL's pink line in Bålsta and travel further on their network? Travel in the other direction with SJ and reach Västerås in about 15 minutes! In the Skiftnycklen quarter, EHB has built 146 rental homes, of which 58 are youth homes in Bahco's former headquarters.

title: Västgötaresan 56 A
description: In the heart of Sävja, Trähuset is emerging - a climate-smart residence built entirely in wood, next door to the Lunsen nature reserve and with services such as a grocery store, pharmacy and schools within easy reach. The property is certified according to Miljöbyggnad Silver and NollCO2, has solar cells for its own electricity and recycled windows. Here you live in a bright and well-planned apartment with parquet floors, white-painted walls and a stylish kitchen from Noblessa equipped with a dishwasher. The bathroom is fully tiled and prepared for a washing machine. Courtyard, bicycle room and modern laundry room make everyday life comfortable. Sustainable housing - for you and the future. Parking spaces on ground level. A parking space can be searched after signing a rental agreement. Charging points will be available.
area_description: The district of Sävja is an established district in the southern parts of Uppsala. The wooden house is a welcome addition to new rental housing in the grown-up environment. Most of the services you need in everyday life can be found in the immediate area. You will find a larger selection with, among other things, a large grocery store, interior design stores, system companies and Ikea in the nearby district of Boländerna. Lockar city has wide and lighted footpaths and cycle paths for those who like to get there on foot or by bicycle. If you want to go by public transport, there is a bus stop right outside the door with frequent bus trips to the city and the travel centre. In addition, there are plans for a future tramway through the area. With the car, you can quickly get out on the E4 for travel in different directions. If you like being out in nature, take your dog, a family member or a group of friends with you and recharge your energy in the forest right next door. For those who like to work up a sweat, there is an easily accessible outdoor gym at Sävja Idrottsplats. The nearby and popular Sunnerstabacken is an obvious place to hang out if you like mountain biking, skiing, snowboarding or sledding. It is also not far to Lake Ekoln for those who like swimming, sailing, fishing and, in the winter when the ice melts, ice skating.

title: Kantorsgatan 28 - 230
description: Student apartment at Kantorsgatan 28 with balcony Kantorsgatan, Rikshem's largest student area in Uppsala. Kantorsgatan is located in the pleasant area of ​​Kvarngärdet, which is about two kilometers from the center of Uppsala. Here you live in a student apartment with 2 rooms and a kitchen. The residence has an associated storage room. Heat and hot water are included in the rent. Electricity is extra. A broadband connection of 1 Mbit/s is included in the rent for you as a tenant when you connect to the open network via fiber. You sign up for broadband subscriptions with higher speeds yourself via Z-market. Drop-in laundry is located in the basement at Kantorsgatan 34. (The rent is stated at the 2025 level and will be adjusted when the 2026 rent negotiations are completed) Short-term contract The residential area is undergoing extensive renovations, vacant homes in this area are therefore rented out on SHORT-TERM CONTRACT. The accommodation is rented out temporarily and you as a tenant have the opportunity to stay until Rikshem needs the accommodation.  The agreement runs one month at a time with a calendar month's notice period and an agreement regarding waiver of security of tenure must be signed when the agreement is written. The accommodation is rented as is and only necessary repairs are carried out. ATTENTION! The home must not be renovated. However, it may be used as evacuation housing during ongoing renovations on Kantorsgatan. The new tenant can pick up his keys to the apartment and the property no earlier than November 1 at 14:00. As the 1st falls on a holiday, the following weekday applies according to the Rent Act.
area_description: Kvarngärdet is a popular and close to the city residential area with proximity to everything. Here you will find grocery stores, gyms, parking garages and schools to name a few. With good public transport connections, you can get to Uppsala University in just a couple of minutes, and the same of course also applies to the popular student nations. If you need to travel further, you can walk to the Uppsala Travel Center in just under 10 minutes and then it's off, with whatever method of travel and direction you choose. To the south, Arlanda and Stockholm are easily accessible by train, bus and car. West of Uppsala, you can easily reach Enköping and Västerås with direct buses. With Upptåget you get quickly to Gävle and its intermediate stations. If you want to feel the pulse of the city, it is just as close to Uppsala's city centre. Here you can experience everything from shopping, restaurants, entertainment and various cultural events. Perhaps you prefer a more leisurely pace and would rather enjoy a walk or a moment's rest on a park bench. Lush green areas and parks are literally just around the corner. Not least Kapellgärdsparken, which really has something for everyone. Toboggan run, large open grass areas for picnics, park benches, a skateboard park and skate boule, playground and an outdoor gym. A very popular excursion destination for both adults and children, all year round. Everyone can find their favorite place here.

title: Brunnbyvägen 104A
description: Pingla housing is located along Brunnbyvägen in the northern parts of popular Alsike. Here you live in a pleasant environment with safe surroundings and an excellent geographical location. Preschool and school are right outside the door, the grocery store a short walk away, as well as the bus that easily takes you to Knivsta or Uppsala. If you want both rural tranquility and proximity to larger cities, Pingla housing is for you. Here you get both. The 46 apartments are housed in a long narrow residential building built on different levels. The house has gray walls with red window frames, the balconies are covered with perforated metal and the roofs in the south are equipped with solar cells. The apartments have parquet floors throughout and brightly painted walls and ceilings. The bathroom has a shower and washbasin commode, the walls are covered with tiles and there is a plastic carpet on the floor. In the kitchen, the smooth doors and drawers are painted in a white color and the worktops are made of laminate. The kitchen is equipped with a fridge and freezer or a combined fridge/freezer, as well as a stove with hob. The apartments are available in many different sizes with varying floor plans. Some of the apartments on the top floor also have sloping ceilings that give the rooms extra character. All one-bedroom apartments have an area of ​​approximately 34 m, two-bedroom apartments 53-68 m and three-bedroom apartments are available in sizes from 70 m all the way up to 93 m. If you are looking for a four-room apartment, there are several square-smart options of 74-83 m, but also an apartment of a whopping 108.6 m. Many exciting variants to suit different family compositions. Shared laundry is centrally located in the building. On the farm there are parking lots and a separate environmental building, but also space for pleasant outdoor activities.
area_description: Alsike is directly adjacent to Knivsta. To Uppsala and Arlanda it is 2 miles and to Stockholm approximately 5.5 miles. In other words, an excellent commuting location. Just under 20,000 people live in the entire municipality of Knivsta, and of those around 5,000 live and enjoy themselves in Alsike. In Alsike there is a grocery store, pizzeria, gym, exercise track, mountain bike course, playgrounds and padel courts. In addition, there are fine forest areas excellent for berry and mushroom picking or walking. Knivsta has a large selection for those who like outdoor life, sports and exercise. To name a few gems, both Lake Mälaren and Lake Valloxen offer nice swimming spots, and Morga Hage and Gredelby Hage are two nature reserves excellent for excursions, picnics or adventures. In addition, Knivsta has a rich and active association life for both young and old. As a resident of Alsike, you can advantageously enjoy living and let your family grow up in a quiet and peaceful area with many options around the corner. Welcome to Pingla housing.

area_description: As a resident of Knivsta, you not only have the lovely nature as a neighbor, but also a very good starting point for commuting to work. The train between Stockholm and Uppsala stops in the middle of central Knivsta, and it takes 29 minutes to reach Stockholm Central and 9 minutes to the station in Uppsala. The Segerdal neighborhood will become Knivsta's new heart in the city center and form the puzzle piece that links the new sawmill square with Knivsta's older, smaller-scale center. From having been a small station community, which then became an industrial community and then a commuter community, Knivsta will now develop into a small town with its own attractiveness. Until 2025, the municipality's vision is for the population to increase from today's roughly 18,000 to 25,000 inhabitants.

area_description: Kvarngärdet is a popular and close to the city residential area with proximity to everything. Here you will find grocery stores, gyms, parking garages and schools to name a few. With good public transport connections, you can get to Uppsala University in just a couple of minutes, and the same of course also applies to the popular student nations. If you need to travel further, you can walk to the Uppsala Travel Center in just under 10 minutes and then it's off, with whatever method of travel and direction you choose. To the south, Arlanda and Stockholm are easily accessible by train, bus and car. West of Uppsala, you can easily reach Enköping and Västerås with direct buses. With Upptåget you get quickly to Gävle and its intermediate stations. If you want to feel the pulse of the city, it is just as close to Uppsala's city centre. Here you can experience everything from shopping, restaurants, entertainment and various cultural events. Perhaps you prefer a more leisurely pace and would rather enjoy a walk or a moment's rest on a park bench. Lush green areas and parks are literally just around the corner. Not least Kapellgärdsparken, which really has something for everyone. Toboggan run, large open grass areas for picnics, park benches, a skateboard park and skate boule, playground and an outdoor gym. A very popular excursion destination for both adults and children, all year round. Everyone can find their favorite place here.

Here you live in a well-planned home with white-painted walls and large, stylish black windows that let in a lot of daylight. The kitchen is equipped with white kitchen doors, dishwasher and combined fridge and freezer. The fully tiled bathroom has retro glass shower walls and a practical combi washing machine. In the hall there is an easy-to-maintain tiled floor, while in the other rooms you walk on a hard-wearing oak parquet floor. The home also has a well-sized wardrobe. If you want to relax or spend time with loved ones, there is a cozy communal courtyard easily accessible. For the next 10 years, the rent will only increase by 2% per year. Perfect for those who want to keep track of their future expenses.
area_description: The brickyard was built in 2020 and has an excellent location between two large grocery stores. The train station is only 300 m from the residence and from there you can get to Stockholm in about 30 minutes and Uppsala in about 10 minutes. The majority of large grocery stores, preschools, schools, hairdressers and restaurants are nearby. In Knivsta, you are never far from nature. Beautiful nature reserves, mushroom-rich forests and cooling bathing spots are close by, even if you live in the middle of the city centre.
